common.controls: matched loaded/unloaded, packet-momentum reversal, global sign where defined, fixed y/z swap/reflection
common.gate: all values finite; deterministic repeat hash; one-local-step domain per update; no fitted threshold
common.input_lift: existing EMX011 packet/background copied to primary component; every added component initialized zero
common.mapping: all 76 retained constraints; added state reported non-equivalently

families.geometry: three-site neutral cell at each site
families.update: unit N6 harmonic plus fixed cyclic onsite couplings 1/4 between 0-1,1-2,2-0

families.geometry: two labels L/U with no physical interpretation
families.update: unit in-layer N6 plus +/-1/4 reciprocal layer displacement coupling
unit in-layer N6 plus fixed 1/4 adjacent label couplings 0-1 and 1-2
q(n+1)=sign(q(n)+sum_N6 q_neighbor) with sign(0)=+1; u,p unit harmonic with fixed q/4 local displacement bias
unit N6 harmonic plus fixed axial distance-two harmonic coefficient 1/4

families.geometry: one predeclared site mark, periodic boundary unchanged
families.update: unit N6 harmonic with one fixed neutral stiffness mark 1/2 at inherited packet center (1,5,5)
explicit kick-drift unit N6 harmonic; dt=.04; finite-domain one-neighbor update

initialization.rule: The exact existing DEV196 valid-state addition is reused only as an initial-state construction; no trajectory superposition is permitted.

do not alter normalization after results
